description: Put an image, video or audio file into your real Switch Editor project (its media and the end of its timeline). Three ways: url (an https link to the file; Switch keeps a copy), video_id (one of your finished videos from list_my_videos, attached as it is), or bytes (call with presign=true, PUT the bytes to upload_url, then call again with confirm_path). A video gets its scrub copy made right away so the project opens ready.

confirm_path.description: The path from the presign answer, on the second call after the PUT, to place the file in the project.

duration_seconds.description: The clip length in seconds, if known. A still image with none given is placed as a 5-second clip.

filename.description: The file name with its extension.

mime.description: The file type, for example video/mp4.

presign.description: true on the first call: answers an upload_url to PUT the bytes to and the path to confirm.

project_id.description: The Editor project id, from list_editor_projects.

url.description: An https link to the file to bring in (no presign needed).

video_id.description: One of your finished videos (list_my_videos) to attach as it is.

name: upload_editor_media
title: Upload Editor Media
